descriptionByLocale.it:
Gestione eventi di Flagship

Principali responsabilità
• Guidare la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di eventi di punta dei clienti.
• Gestisci tempi, pietre miliari e consegna end-to-end per garantire l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione.
• Stabilire la governance del progetto e preparare e condurre riunioni del comitato direttivo.
• Monitorare i progressi del progetto, gestire i rischi e le dipendenze, e facilitare il processo decisionale tempestivo.
• Allineare e coordinare le parti interessate interfunzionali, comprese le linee di prodotto, le industrie, le vendite e le squadre regionali MarCom.
• Promuovere una collaborazione efficace e gestire le comunicazioni di progetto in tutte le parti coinvolte.
• Gestisci budget per eventi, attività di approvvigionamento e selezione e prestazioni dell'agenzia.
• Monitorare le spese e le previsioni garantendo al tempo stesso il rispetto dei bilanci approvati.
• Definire e monitorare i KPI, valutare le prestazioni e i risultati degli eventi e fornire report post-evento.
• Le lezioni di acquisizione hanno imparato e raccomandano miglioramenti per i futuri eventi di punta.

Competenze, competenze e esperienza

Esperienza
• Esperienza comprovata gestione indipendente complesso, eventi su larga scala end-to-end, idealmente B2B fiere , mostre, o simili programmi multi-stakeholder
• Esperienza dimostrata tradurre un brief strategico in un piano completo di eventi operativi e guidarlo attraverso la consegna
• Esperienza di gestione di più flussi di lavoro paralleli con interdipendenze significative
• Proprietà comprovata dei bilanci di eventi sostanziali
• Forte esperienza gestionale agenzie e fornitori attraverso la produzione e la consegna
• Esperienza di lavoro in organizzazioni complesse, internazionali e interfunzionali
• L'esperienza in un ambiente industriale, tecnologico o B2B sarebbe un forte vantaggio

Competenze
• Gestione avanzata del progetto e del programma
• Pianificazione del bilancio e gestione dei costi
• Gestione del rischio e della dipendenza
• Informatica e gestione delle prestazioni
• Progetto di governance e facilitazione del comitato direttivo
• Ottima comunicazione e coordinamento degli stakeholder
• Ottimo inglese scritto e verbale; francese e/o tedesco sarebbe un vantaggio

Competenze
• Alto livello di autonomia e di proprietà, con forte responsabilità per la consegna
• Capacità di tradurre direzione strategica in esecuzione operativa strutturata
• Proattiva e orientata alla soluzione, in grado di anticipare i rischi e le decisioni di azionamento
• Forte leadership degli stakeholder, con la capacità di allineare e mobilitare i team interfunzionali
• In grado di bilanciare l'autonomia operativa con allineamento strategico, aumentando con raccomandazioni chiare quando necessario
descriptionByLocale.en:
Flagship Event Manager

Key Responsibilities
• Lead the planning and execution of flagship customer events.
• Manage event timelines, milestones, and end-to-end delivery to ensure execution excellence.
• Establish project governance and prepare and lead steering committee meetings.
• Monitor project progress, manage risks and dependencies, and facilitate timely decision-making.
• Align and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, including Product Lines, Industries, Sales, and Regional MarCom teams.
• Foster effective collaboration and manage project communications across all involved parties.
• Manage event budgets, procurement activities, and agency selection and performance.
• Monitor spending and forecasts while ensuring compliance with approved budgets.
• Define and track KPIs, evaluate event performance and outcomes, and deliver post-event reporting.
• Capture lessons learned and recommend improvements for future flagship events.

Competencies, Skills & Experience

Experience
• Proven experience independently managing complex, large-scale events end-to-end, ideally B2B trade shows , exhibitions, or comparable multi-stakeholder programs
• Demonstrated experience translating a strategic brief into a complete operational event plan and driving it through delivery
• Experience managing multiple parallel workstreams with significant interdependencies
• Proven ownership of substantial event budgets
• Strong experience managing agencies and suppliers through production and delivery
• Experience working in complex, international and cross-functional organizations
• Experience in an industrial, technology or B2B environment would be a strong advantage

Skills
• Advanced project and program management
• Budget planning and cost management
• Risk and dependency management
• Agency briefing and performance management
• Project governance and steering committee facilitation
• Excellent stakeholder communication and coordination
• Excellent written and verbal English; French and/or German would be an advantage

Competencies
• High level of autonomy and ownership, with strong accountability for delivery
• Ability to translate strategic direction into structured operational execution
• Proactive and solution-oriented, able to anticipate risks and drive decisions
• Strong stakeholder leadership, with the ability to align and mobilize cross-functional teams
• Able to balance operational autonomy with strategic alignment, escalating with clear recommendations when needed
descriptionByLocale.de:
Flagship Event Manager

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Führen Sie die Planung und Durchführung von Flaggschiff-Kundenveranstaltungen.
• Verwalten Sie Ereigniszeitpläne, Meilensteine und End-to-End-Lieferung, um eine hervorragende Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Einrichtung der Projektsteuerung und Vorbereitung und Leitung der Sitzungen des Lenkungsausschusses.
• Überwachen Sie den Projektfortschritt, verwalten Sie Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und erleichtern Sie die rechtzeitige Entscheidungsfindung.
• Ausrichtung und Koordination funktionsübergreifender Stakeholder, einschließlich Produktlinien, Branchen, Vertrieb und regionaler MarCom-Teams.
• Förderung einer effektiven Zusammenarbeit und Verwaltung der Projektkommunikation über alle beteiligten Parteien hinweg.
• Verwalten Sie Veranstaltungsbudgets, Beschaffungsaktivitäten sowie Agenturauswahl und -leistung.
• Überwachung der Ausgaben und Prognosen bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der genehmigten Budgets.
• Definieren und verfolgen Sie KPIs, bewerten Sie Ereignisleistung und -ergebnisse und liefern Sie Post-Event-Reporting.
• Erfassen Sie die gewonnenen Lektionen und empfehlen Sie Verbesserungen für zukünftige Flaggschiff-Events.

Kompetenzen, Fähigkeiten & Erfahrungen

Erfahrung
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der unabhängigen Verwaltung komplexer Großveranstaltungen, idealerweise B2B-Messen, Ausstellungen oder vergleichbarer Multi-Stakeholder-Programme
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung bei der Übersetzung eines strategischen Briefs in einen vollständigen operativen Ereignisplan und dessen Umsetzung durch die Lieferung
• Erfahrung im Management mehrerer paralleler Workstreams mit signifikanten Interdependenzen
• Nachgewiesener Besitz von erheblichen Eventbudgets
• Starke Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Agenturen und Lieferanten durch Produktion und Lieferung
• Erfahrung in komplexen, internationalen und funktionsübergreifenden Organisationen
• Erfahrung in einer Industrie-, Technologie- oder B2B-Umgebung wäre ein großer Vorteil

Fähigkeiten
• Fortgeschrittenes Projekt- und Programmmanagement
• Budgetplanung und Kostenmanagement
• Risiko- und Abhängigkeitsmanagement
• Agenturbriefing und Leistungsmanagement
• Projektsteuerung und Erleichterung des Lenkungsausschusses
• Exzellente Stakeholder-Kommunikation und Koordination
• Ausgezeichnetes schriftliches und verbales Englisch; Französisch und / oder Deutsch wäre von Vorteil

Kompetenzen
• Hohe Autonomie und Eigenverantwortung mit starker Rechenschaftspflicht für die Lieferung
• Fähigkeit, strategische Ausrichtung in strukturierte operative Ausführung zu übersetzen
• Proaktiv und lösungsorientiert, in der Lage, Risiken zu antizipieren und Entscheidungen zu treffen
• Starke Stakeholder-Führung mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams auszurichten und zu mobilisieren
• Kann operative Autonomie mit strategischer Ausrichtung in Einklang bringen und bei Bedarf mit klaren Empfehlungen eskalieren
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Gestionnaire d'événements phares

Principales responsabilités
• Diriger la planification et l'exécution des événements phares de la clientèle.
• Gérer les échéances, les jalons et l'exécution de bout en bout pour assurer l'excellence de l'exécution.
• Établir la gouvernance du projet et préparer et diriger les réunions du comité directeur.
• Surveiller l'avancement du projet, gérer les risques et les dépendances et faciliter la prise de décisions en temps opportun.
• Aligner et coordonner les intervenants interfonctionnels, y compris les lignes de produits, les industries, les ventes et les équipes régionales du MarCom.
• Favoriser une collaboration efficace et gérer les communications des projets entre toutes les parties concernées.
• Gérer les budgets des événements, les activités d'approvisionnement et la sélection et le rendement des organismes.
• Surveiller les dépenses et les prévisions tout en veillant au respect des budgets approuvés.
• Définir et suivre les ICR, évaluer le rendement et les résultats des événements et produire des rapports après les événements.
• Saisir les leçons apprises et recommander des améliorations pour les futures manifestations phares.

Compétences, compétences et expérience

Expérience
• Expérience éprouvée en gestion indépendante d'événements complexes à grande échelle, idéalement des salons B2B, des expositions ou des programmes multipartenaires comparables
• Expérience démontrée transformant un mémoire stratégique en un plan opérationnel complet et le faisant passer à la livraison
• Expérience dans la gestion de multiples flux de travail parallèles avec des interdépendances importantes
• Propriété avérée de budgets d'événements importants
• Forte expérience de la gestion des agences et des fournisseurs grâce à la production et à la livraison
• Expérience de travail dans des organisations complexes, internationales et interfonctionnelles
• L'expérience dans un environnement industriel, technologique ou B2B serait un avantage important

Compétences
• Gestion avancée de projets et de programmes
• Planification budgétaire et gestion des coûts
• Gestion des risques et de la dépendance
• Réunion d'information et gestion du rendement de l'Agence
• Gouvernance du projet et facilitation du comité directeur
• Excellente communication et coordination des parties prenantes
• Excellent anglais écrit et verbal; français et/ou allemand serait un avantage

Compétences
• Niveau élevé d'autonomie et d'appropriation, avec une forte responsabilité pour l'exécution
• Capacité de traduire l'orientation stratégique en exécution opérationnelle structurée
• Proactive et orientée vers la solution, capable d'anticiper les risques et de conduire les décisions
• Un leadership fort des parties prenantes, capable d'aligner et de mobiliser les équipes interfonctionnelles
• Être en mesure d'équilibrer l'autonomie opérationnelle et l'alignement stratégique, et de formuler des recommandations claires au besoin

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabile della gestione dei progetti clienti

Principali responsabilità
• Definire e distribuire la strategia globale di Customer Project Management e il modello operativo allineato alle priorità aziendali.
• Guidare e sviluppare un'organizzazione globale altamente performante, promuovere la crescita del talento, coaching e pianificazione di successione.
• Superare il portafoglio di progetti clienti in tutto il mondo, assicurando la consegna contro gli impegni contrattuali per ambito, programma, costo, qualità, redditività e soddisfazione del cliente.
• Stabilire e mantenere la governance globale del progetto, metodologie, standard, strumenti, KPI e pratiche di reporting.
• Guida recensioni portafoglio e fornire visibilità a livello esecutivo sulle prestazioni del progetto, rischi, opportunità, reclami e requisiti di risorse.
• Atto come sponsor esecutivo per progetti strategici o critici del cliente e piani di recupero di piombo quando necessario.
• Rafforzare la collaborazione tra funzioni e regioni per migliorare l'esecuzione del progetto end-to-end.
• Assicurare una gestione rigorosa della redditività del progetto, del flusso di cassa, delle previsioni, della gestione dei cambiamenti e della mitigazione dei rischi.
• Costruire forti relazioni con i clienti di livello esecutivo e sostenere gli obiettivi aziendali chiave.
• Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo e digitalizzazione per migliorare le capacità di gestione del progetto e il processo decisionale.
• Garantire il rispetto dei requisiti contrattuali, delle politiche interne, degli standard di qualità e delle normative sulla sicurezza e la salute

Profilo
• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Business Administration, Project Management, o un campo relativo. L'MBA e' un vantaggio.
• Ampia esperienza di leadership nella gestione globale del progetto dei clienti all'interno di attrezzature industriali, ingegnerizzati per l'ordine o ambienti di beni di capitale.
• Forte track record di grandi squadre internazionali e multiculturali.
• Esperienza dimostrata che gestisce complessi portafogli di progetto globali con responsabilità per ricavi, margini, cash flow, soddisfazione del cliente e rischio.
• Competenze profonde nella governance del progetto, nella gestione dei contratti, nella gestione finanziaria, nella gestione dei rischi e nel recupero dei progetti.
• Forte acume economico e finanziario con la capacità di bilanciare le priorità strategiche e operative.
• Presenza esecutiva con eccellente gestione delle parti interessate e competenze influenti.
• Prova capacità di guidare la trasformazione organizzativa e il miglioramento continuo.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e leadership.
• Fluente in inglese; francese e/o tedesco sono considerati beni forti.
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Head of Customer Project Management

Key Responsibilities
• Define and deploy the global Customer Project Management strategy and operating model aligned with business priorities.
• Lead and develop a high-performing global organization, fostering talent growth, coaching, and succession planning.
• Oversee the worldwide customer project portfolio, ensuring delivery against contractual commitments for scope, schedule, cost, quality, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
• Establish and maintain global project governance, methodologies, standards, tools, KPIs, and reporting practices.
• Drive portfolio reviews and provide executive-level visibility on project performance, risks, opportunities, claims, and resource requirements.
• Act as executive sponsor for strategic or critical customer projects and lead recovery plans when required.
• Strengthen collaboration across functions and regions to improve end-to-end project execution.
• Ensure rigorous management of project profitability, cash flow, forecasting, change management, and risk mitigation.
• Build strong executive-level customer relationships and support key business objectives.
• Lead continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives to enhance project management capabilities and decision-making.
• Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, internal policies, quality standards, and health & safety regulations

Profile
• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
• Extensive leadership experience in global customer project management within industrial equipment, engineered-to-order, or capital goods environments.
• Strong track record of leading large international and multicultural teams.
• Demonstrated experience managing complex global project portfolios with accountability for revenue, margins, cash flow, customer satisfaction, and risk.
• Deep expertise in project governance, contract management, financial management, risk management, and project recovery.
• Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to balance strategic and operational priorities.
• Executive presence with excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
• Proven ability to drive organizational transformation and continuous improvement.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership capabilities.
• Fluent in English; French and/or German are considered strong assets.
• Willingness to travel internationally.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Leiter Kundenprojektmanagement

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Customer Project Management Strategie und das Betriebsmodell, die auf die Geschäftsprioritäten ausgerichtet sind.
• Führen und entwickeln Sie eine leistungsstarke globale Organisation, die Talentwachstum, Coaching und Nachfolgeplanung fördert.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie das weltweite Kundenprojektportfolio und gewährleisten Sie die Lieferung gegen vertragliche Verpflichtungen in Bezug auf Umfang, Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, Rentabilität und Kundenzufriedenheit.
• Etablieren und pflegen Sie globale Projekt-Governance, Methoden, Standards, Tools, KPIs und Berichtspraktiken.
• Fördern Sie Portfolio-Reviews und bieten Sie Transparenz auf Führungsebene über Projektleistung, Risiken, Chancen, Ansprüche und Ressourcenanforderungen.
• Handeln Sie als Executive Sponsor für strategische oder kritische Kundenprojekte und führen Sie bei Bedarf Wiederherstellungspläne.
• Stärkung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Funktionen und Regionen, um die End-to-End-Projektausführung zu verbessern.
• Gewährleistung eines strengen Managements der Projektrentabilität, des Cashflows, der Prognose, des Change Managements und der Risikominderung.
• Aufbau starker Kundenbeziehungen auf Führungsebene und Unterstützung wichtiger Geschäftsziele.
• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungs- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen, um die Projektmanagementfähigkeiten und -entscheidungen zu verbessern.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung vertraglicher Anforderungen, interner Richtlinien, Qualitätsstandards und Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsvorschriften

Profil
• Master-Abschluss in Engineering, Business Administration, Projektmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich. MBA ist ein Plus.
• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrung im globalen Kundenprojektmanagement in Industrieanlagen, Engineering-to-Order- oder Investitionsgüterumgebungen.
• Starke Erfolgsbilanz der führenden großen internationalen und multikulturellen Teams.
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung im Management komplexer globaler Projektportfolios mit Rechenschaftspflicht für Umsatz, Margen, Cashflow, Kundenzufriedenheit und Risiko.
• Tiefe Expertise in den Bereichen Projekt Governance, Vertragsmanagement, Finanzmanagement, Risikomanagement und Projektwiederherstellung.
• Starker Geschäfts- und Finanzsinn mit der Fähigkeit, strategische und operative Prioritäten auszugleichen.
• Executive Präsenz mit exzellentem Stakeholder Management und beeinflussenden Fähigkeiten.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, organisatorische Transformation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung voranzutreiben.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Führungsqualitäten.
• Fließend in Englisch; Französisch und / oder Deutsch gelten als starke Vermögenswerte.
• Bereitschaft, international zu reisen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chef de la gestion du projet client

Principales responsabilités
• Définir et déployer la stratégie globale de gestion de projet client et le modèle opérationnel alignés sur les priorités opérationnelles.
• Diriger et développer une organisation mondiale performante, favorisant la croissance des talents, le coaching et la planification de la relève.
• Surveillez le portefeuille mondial de projets clients, en assurant la livraison par rapport aux engagements contractuels pour la portée, le calendrier, le coût, la qualité, la rentabilité et la satisfaction du client.
• Établir et maintenir la gouvernance globale des projets, les méthodes, les normes, les outils, les ICR et les pratiques en matière de rapports.
• Diriger les examens du portefeuille et donner une visibilité aux cadres supérieurs sur le rendement du projet, les risques, les possibilités, les demandes de remboursement et les besoins en ressources.
• Agir en tant que commanditaire exécutif pour les projets stratégiques ou critiques des clients et diriger les plans de rétablissement au besoin.
• Renforcer la collaboration entre les fonctions et les régions afin d'améliorer l'exécution des projets de bout en bout.
• Assurer une gestion rigoureuse de la rentabilité du projet, des flux de trésorerie, des prévisions, de la gestion du changement et de l'atténuation des risques.
• Établir de solides relations avec la clientèle au niveau de la direction et soutenir les principaux objectifs opérationnels.
• Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue et de numérisation pour améliorer les capacités de gestion de projet et la prise de décisions.
• Veiller au respect des exigences contractuelles, des politiques internes, des normes de qualité et des règlements en matière de santé et de sécurité

Profil
• Maîtrise en génie, administration des affaires, gestion de projet ou domaine connexe. MBA est un plus.
• Une vaste expérience de leadership dans la gestion globale de projets clients dans des environnements d'équipement industriel, d'ingénierie à commande ou de biens d'équipement.
• Forte expérience des grandes équipes internationales et multiculturelles.
• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de portefeuilles de projets mondiaux complexes, avec obligation de rendre compte des recettes, des marges, des flux de trésorerie, de la satisfaction de la clientèle et des risques.
• Une expertise approfondie en gouvernance de projet, gestion des contrats, gestion financière, gestion des risques et recouvrement de projet.
• Forte concentration des activités et des finances avec la capacité d'équilibrer les priorités stratégiques et opérationnelles.
• Présence de la haute direction avec une excellente gestion des intervenants et une influence sur les compétences.
• Capacité éprouvée de stimuler la transformation organisationnelle et l'amélioration continue.
• Excellente capacité de communication, de négociation et de leadership.
• Le français et/ou l'allemand sont considérés comme de solides atouts.
• Volonté de voyager à l'étranger.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabile dell'eccellenza delle vendite

Principali responsabilità
• Guida l'agenda globale di Sales Excellence, guida processi di vendita armonizzati, metodologie e strumenti in tutte le regioni e industrie.
• Definire e privilegiare i miglioramenti del processo di vendita, garantendo l'allineamento con le esigenze aziendali e le aspettative degli stakeholder.
• Guidare la distribuzione, l'adozione e il miglioramento continuo dei processi di vendita e delle migliori pratiche in tutto il mondo.
• Guidare la strategia, la governance e l'ottimizzazione di strumenti commerciali, tra cui CRM, l'automazione delle vendite e piattaforme di analisi.
• Contabile per Customer Satisfaction / Customer Experience, tra cui NPS e vendite tele
• Stabilire e mantenere elevati standard di qualità, integrità e governance dei dati attraverso i sistemi commerciali.
• Partner con team business e IT per implementare soluzioni di vendita scalabili e massimizzare l'adozione degli utenti.
• Definire e governare i quadri di performance di vendita, KPI, dashboard e processi di reporting allineati con la strategia aziendale.
• Facilitare le recensioni sulle prestazioni, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e promuovere la migliore condivisione delle pratiche in tutte le regioni.
• Promuovere una cultura di eccellenza delle vendite migliorando le capacità commerciali, i programmi di bordo e le iniziative di formazione.
• Definire e distribuire programmi di implementazione delle vendite globali, framework di competenza, percorsi di certificazione, processi di bordo e piattaforme di condivisione delle conoscenze.
• Supporto e coach team regionali attraverso competenze nelle metodologie di vendita, strumenti e pratiche di negoziazione.
• Condurre la trasformazione verso un processo di vendita unificato, un ecosistema CRM, e un approccio di soluzione-selling in tutta l'organizzazione.

Competenze e capacità
• Prova leadership nelle iniziative di eccellenza e trasformazione delle vendite.
• Forte gestione degli stakeholder e influenzando le competenze in un ambiente di matrice globale.
• Competenza in CRM, processi di vendita e gestione delle prestazioni commerciali.
• Mindset Data-driven con forti capacità analitiche e problem-solving.
• Cambiare le competenze di gestione e miglioramento continuo.
• Forte capacità di gestione e esecuzione del progetto.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione.
• Pensatore strategico con un approccio pratico e mentalità orientata al cliente.
• Metodologia di vendita
• Leadership della trasformazione digitale
• Gestione del viaggio dei clienti

Qualificazioni predestinate
• Laurea magistrale in Business Administration, Marketing, Ingegneria o campo relativo.
• Esperienza significativa in Eccellenza di Vendite, Eccellenza Commerciale, Operazioni di Vendite o ruoli di Trasformazione di Vendite.

Mechanical Design Product Owner BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now BOBST is looking for its group Mechanical Design Product Owner. At BOBST , you will play a central role in enhancing the Mechanical design environments and methodologies used across our engineering teams. Build, prioritize, and manage the product backlog based on business value and engineering needs.

Drive the adoption of MCAD best practices , modelling standards, configuration management principles, and design workflows.

Business transformation of the MCAD application portfoli o to support decommissioning of legacy app and practices towards the target set of applications and processes

Work closely with mechanical engineering teams, including local key users, to understand pain points and translate them into actionable user stories.

Collaborate with IT, and downstream functions (Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Simulation, Quality) to ensure alignment and data continuity.

Communicate updates, decisions, changes, and expectations clearly across the organization.

Lead and support enhancements, upgrades, and new functionalities across CATIA, 3DEXPERIENCE, and related tools—particularly within the BOBST Transformation Program .

descriptionByLocale.it: Tecnico di servizio di campo - Ingegnere di montaggio esterno (H/F) BSA - Bobst Mex SA Applicare all'interno della Business Unit Services & Performance, vi offriamo l'opportunità di aderire alla nostra piscina di montaggio esterna come un Field Service Technician - livello di ingegneria. Si tratta di un contratto a tempo indeterminato, tasso di attività al 100%, basato sul nostro sito Mex (centrale sociale e produzione). Il lavoro di Field Service Technician richiede un forte desiderio e disponibilità di andare in missione con i nostri clienti all'estero dal 40 al 60% del vostro tempo all'anno in diverse settimane di fila (4 a 6 settimane in generale). TUA MISSIONE: mettere in servizio le attrezzature della linea di prodotti con i nostri clienti in Svizzera e all'estero, in tutto il mondo Controllo e sistemi di azionamento (motion control) Formare il personale dei nostri clienti nella manutenzione delle nostre attrezzature e l'uso della documentazione tecnica Collabora con diversi servizi relativi alla linea di prodotti (Supporto tecnico, R&D, marketing, formazione) Assicurare il supporto funzionale dei nostri prodotti dalle loro concezioni Risoluzione dei problemi e assistenza tecnica in-house e ai nostri clienti Hai un HES o un grado equivalente in ingegneria elettrica o automazione Siete disposti a viaggiare all'estero (circa il 60% del vostro tempo per lunghi periodi) ai nostri clienti e alle nostre filiali
descriptionByLocale.en: Field Service Technician - External Mount Engineer (H/F) BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply Within the Business Unit Services & Performance, we offer you the opportunity to join our External Mounting Pool as a Field Service Technician - engineering level. This is an indefinite contract, 100% activity rate, based on our Mex site (social headquarters and production). The job of Field Service Technician requires a strong desire and availability to go on a mission with our customers abroad from 40 to 60% of your time per year over several weeks in a row (4 to 6 weeks in general). YOUR MISSION: Putting product line equipment into service with our customers in Switzerland and abroad, worldwide Control control and drive systems (motion control) Train our customers' staff in the maintenance of our equipment and the use of technical documentation Collaborate with different services related to the product line (Technical support, R&D, marketing, training) Ensure the functional support of our products from their conceptions Troubleshooting and providing technical assistance in-house and to our clients You have an HES or equivalent degree in electrical engineering or automation You are willing to travel abroad (about 60% of your time for long periods) to our customers and to our subsidiaries
descriptionByLocale.de: Field Service Technician - External Mount Engineer (H/F) BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply Innerhalb der Business Unit Services & Performance bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, unserem externen Montagepool als Field Service Technician - Engineering Level beizutreten. Dies ist ein unbefristeter Vertrag, 100% Aktivitätsrate, basierend auf unserem Mex-Standort (soziale Zentrale und Produktion). Der Job des Außendiensttechnikers erfordert einen starken Wunsch und die Verfügbarkeit, um mit unseren Kunden im Ausland von 40 bis 60% Ihrer Zeit pro Jahr über mehrere Wochen in Folge (4 bis 6 Wochen im Allgemeinen) auf Mission zu gehen. IHRE Mission: Produktlinienausrüstung bei unseren Kunden in der Schweiz und im Ausland, weltweit in Betrieb nehmen Steuerungs- und Antriebssysteme (Motion Control) Trainieren Sie die Mitarbeiter unserer Kunden in der Wartung unserer Ausrüstung und der Verwendung der technischen Dokumentation Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Dienstleistungen im Zusammenhang mit der Produktlinie (Technischer Support, R&D, Marketing, Training) Sicherstellen der funktionalen Unterstützung unserer Produkte von ihren Konzeptionen Fehlerbehebung und technische Unterstützung im eigenen Haus und für unsere Kunden Sie haben einen HES oder einen gleichwertigen Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder Automatisierung Sie sind bereit, ins Ausland zu reisen (ca. 60% Ihrer Zeit für längere Zeiträume) zu unseren Kunden und zu unseren Tochtergesellschaften
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control BSA - Bobst Mex SA Postuler Rejoignez notre équipe Web-Fed Solutions Au sein de la Business Unit Services & Performance, nous vous offrons l’opportunité de rejoindre notre Pool de Monteurs Externes Web-Fed Solutions en tant que Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control. Il s’agit d’un contrat à durée indéterminée à 100%, basé sur notre site de Mex (VD), siège social et centre de production. Ce poste s’adresse à un professionnel passionné par les environnements industriels complexes, capable d’intervenir de manière autonome sur des lignes de production automatisées à haute valeur technologique. Vous serez amené à voyager à l’international entre 50% et 60% de votre temps, souvent sur des missions de plusieurs semaines consécutives. VOTRE MISSION Réaliser la mise en service de lignes de production automatisées en Suisse et à l’international.

Effectuer des interventions de retrofit, modernisation et amélioration d’installations existantes.

Planifier et organiser de manière autonome les activités de mise en service sur site.

Diagnostiquer et résoudre des problématiques techniques complexes en automatisation, motion control, électricité et informatique industrielle.

Programmer, modifier et optimiser les systèmes d’automatisation sous Siemens TIA Portal , Siemens S7.

Mettre en service et paramétrer les systèmes d’entraînement et les axes synchronisés.

Réaliser des interventions de dépannage sur site client ou à distance.

Coordonner les activités techniques avec les équipes du client.

At BOBST, your work has a real impact all over the world through innovation and cutting-edge technologies (www.bobst.com). • Ihre Hauptaufgaben: Wartung und Betrieb von Anlagen. Gewährleisten Sie die vorbeugende und heilende Wartung der technischen Anlagen am Standort. descriptionByLocale.it: Technical Service Support Electrical BSG - Bobst Italia Apply now Bobst Italia Spa, sede di Piacenza, è alla ricerca di un/una Technical Service Support Electrical . La nostra sede di Piacenza è specializzata nella vendita e nell'assistenza sul campo di macchinari Bobst per la stampa di cartone ondulato e teso. Il tecnico, da remoto, fornisce un continuo supporto elettrico a clienti e colleghi in campo individuando nel più breve tempo possibile la miglior soluzione alla problematica. Principali mansioni: Supporto tecnico ai clienti e ai tecnici in campo. Risoluzione problematiche di carattere elettrico/elettronico. Gestione dell'action plan, degli interventi e segnalazione inconvenienti. Coordinamento con responsabile, colleghi, tecnici sul campo e uffici tecnici di Losanna e Lyone. Richiediamo un esperienza di almeno 5 anni in attività di service in campo e/o assistenza tecnica da remoto di tipo elettrico all'interno di realtà di produzione di macchine per il cartone oppure macchine da lavorazione meccanica (CNC). Capacità di diagnosticare guasti e formulare raccomndazioni e soluzioni. La conoscenza tecnica di impianti Bobst o simili sarà considerata un plus. Capacità di analisi e attenzione ai dettagli.
descriptionByLocale.en: Technical Service Support Electrical BSG - Bobst Italia Apply now Bobst Italia Spa, based in Piacenza, is looking for an Electrical Technical Service Support. Our office in Piacenza specialises in the sale and field service of Bobst machines for the printing of corrugated and taut cardboard. The technician, remotely, provides continuous electrical support to customers and colleagues in the field, identifying the best solution to the problem as soon as possible. Main tasks: Technical support to customers and technicians in the field. Solving electrical/electronic problems. Management of the action plan, interventions and reporting of problems. Coordination with managers, colleagues, field technicians and technical offices in Lausanne and Lyon. We require experience of at least 5 years in field service activities and/or remote electrical technical assistance within the production of cardboard machines or mechanical processing machines (CNC). Ability to diagnose faults and make recommendations and solutions. Technical knowledge of Bobst or similar systems will be considered a plus. Analytical skills and attention to detail.

Capacité d'analyse et attention aux détails.

descriptionByLocale.it: Responsabile del servizio tecnico BES - Bobst Iberica S.L. Obiettivi - Garantire un'esperienza clienti eccellente attraverso tempi di risposta appropriati, interventi di alta qualità e comunicazione chiara durante l'intero ciclo di servizio. - Ottimizzare la copertura operativa in Spagna e Portogallo garantendo la disponibilità, la pianificazione efficiente e l'uso intelligente delle risorse tecniche. - Guidare il miglioramento continuo all'interno del team TSS attraverso la formazione, il coaching, i feedback e la standardizzazione delle migliori pratiche. - Rafforzare i rapporti con i clienti chiave attraverso visite periodiche, revisioni delle prestazioni e monitoraggio della soddisfazione. - Garantire la sostenibilità finanziaria dell'area di servizio gestendo i margini, i costi e le opportunità di efficienza. Mansioni e Responsabilità Gestione Operativa e Supporto al Cliente - Priorizzare e coordinare tutte le richieste di assistenza tecnica, garantendo i tempi di risposta operativa SLO e la risoluzione efficace. - Agire come punto di contatto principale nei casi complessi, nelle escalation o nelle controversie, garantendo trasparenza e soluzioni orientate al cliente e informando proattivamente il diretto superiore. - Supervisionare la qualità degli interventi, dei resoconti tecnici e della comunicazione post‑servizio. Leadership del Team Tecnico - Garantire che il team sviluppi un alto livello di conoscenze tecniche su diverse linee di prodotto, inclusi aggiornamenti tecnologici e macchinari. - Supervisionare il carico di lavoro e la disponibilità, ottimizzando i compiti e le risorse. - Promuovere una cultura di sicurezza, conformità normativa e professionalità in tutti gli interventi. - Condurre valutazioni delle prestazioni periodiche e coordinare i piani di formazione con HR e il Direttore del Servizio. Gestione Finanziaria dell'Area di Servizio - Essere responsabile dei risultati economici dell'area: margini, costi di cortesia, utilizzo ed efficienza operativa. - Identificare opportunità di miglioramento, iniziative di riduzione dei costi e ottimizzazione dei processi. - Presentare report periodici sui KPI e le proposte di miglioramento al Servizio Management. Coordinamento Interdipartimentale - Collaborare strettamente con PSM, Vendite e Assistenza Clienti, garantendo un flusso di informazioni tecnico-commerciali aggiornate e fluide. - Partecipare a riunioni di pianificazione, revisione dei clienti e analisi degli incidenti ricorrenti. - Contribuire allo sviluppo di nuove soluzioni, miglioramenti dei prodotti e strategie di servizio. Miglioramento Continuo e Standard Interni - Aggiornare annualmente gli standard tecnici del team interno, revisionandoli con HR. - Promuovere iniziative di digitalizzazione, analisi a distanza, strumenti diagnostici e reporting. - Incoraggiare l'uso degli strumenti aziendali tra i membri del team (ad esempio, TeamViewer). - Promuovere la standardizzazione dei processi e la documentazione tecnica di alta qualità. Competenze Chiave - Orientamento al cliente e comunicazione efficace. - Leadership e gestione di team tecnici. - Abilità analitiche e decisioni basate sui dati. - Gestione del cambiamento e miglioramento continuo. - Conoscenza avanzata del portafoglio BOBST. - Collaborazione interfunzionale e consapevolezza aziendale. Unisciti a noi – cresci con noi. BOBST è un'azienda di ingegneria, pioniera di soluzioni intelligenti che plasmano il futuro del mondo dell'imballaggio. In BOBST, fai un impatto a livello globale - attraverso l'innovazione e la tecnologia avanzata. Cresci superando le sfide - in una squadra che mira all'eccellenza. E godere di una cultura di un'azienda a conduzione familiare, dove i valori sono veramente vissuti. Con le forze combinate di oltre 6400 persone e attività aziendali in più di 50 paesi, siamo posizionati come leader dell'innovazione nel nostro settore.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Technical Service Manager BES - Bobst Iberica S.L. Apply now Objective Ensure an excellent customer experience by guaranteeing appropriate response times, high-quality interventions, and clear communication throughout the entire service cycle. Optimize operational coverage in Spain and Portugal by ensuring availability, efficient planning, and smart use of technical resources. Drive continuous improvement within the TSS team through training, coaching, feedback, and the standardization of best practices. Strengthen relationships with key customers through periodic visits, performance reviews, and satisfaction monitoring. Ensure the financial sustainability of the Service area by managing margins, costs, and efficiency opportunities. Functions and 
• Responsibilities 1. Operational Management and Customer Support Prioritize and coordinate all technical assistance requests, ensuring operational SLO response times and effective resolution. Act as the main point of contact in complex cases, escalations, or disputes, ensuring transparency and customer‑oriented solutions while proactively informing the direct manager. Supervise the quality of interventions, technical reports, and post‑service communication. 2. Technical Team Leadership Ensure the team develops a high level of technical knowledge across the different product lines, including new technologies and machine updates. Supervise workload and availability, optimizing tasks and resources. Promote a culture of safety, regulatory compliance, and professionalism in all interventions. Conduct periodic performance evaluations and coordinate training plans with HR and the Service Director. 3. Financial Management of the Service Area Be responsible for the economic results of the area: margins, goodwill costs, utilization, and operational efficiency. Identify improvement opportunities, cost‑reduction initiatives, and process optimization. Present periodic KPI reports and improvement proposals to the Service Management. 4. Interdepartmental Coordination Collaborate closely with PSM, Sales, and Customer Care, ensuring a smooth and updated technical‑commercial information flow. Participate in planning meetings, customer reviews, and analysis of recurring incidents. Contribute to the development of new solutions, product improvements, and service strategies. 5. Continuous Improvement and Internal Standards Keep internal technical team standards updated, reviewing them annually with HR. Promote digitalization initiatives, remote analysis, diagnostic tools, and reporting. Encourage the use of corporate tools among team members (e.g., TeamViewer). Promote process standardization and high‑quality technical documentation. Key Competencies Customer orientation and effective communication. Leadership and management of technical teams. Analytical skills and data‑driven decision‑making. Change management and continuous improvement. Advanced technical knowledge of the BOBST portfolio. Cross‑functional collaboration and business acumen. Join us – and grow with us. BOBST is an engineering company, pioneering intelligent solutions that shape the future of the packaging world. At BOBST, you make an impact on a global scale – through innovation and advanced technology. You grow by mastering challenges – in a team that strives for excellence. And you enjoy a culture of a family-run enterprise, where values are truly lived. With the combined forces of more than 6400 people and business activities in more than 50 countries, we are positioned as the innovation leader in our industry. Apply now Follow us
descriptionByLocale.de: Technischer Serviceleiter BES - Bobst Iberica S.L. Obiettivi – Garantieren Sie unseren Kunden ein erstklassiges Erlebnis, indem Sie angemessene Reaktionszeiten, hohe Qualität und Kommunikation während des gesamten Servicezyklus einhalten. - Die Optimierung der operativen Arbeit in Spanien und Portogallo gewährleistet die Verfügbarkeit, die effiziente Verarbeitung und die intelligente Verwendung der Risikotechnik. - Führen Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung des gesamten TSS-Teams durch die Ausbildung, das Coaching, das Feedback und die Standardisierung der besten Praktiken durch. - Berichterstatter und Berichterstatter mit den Kunden, die regelmäßig Besuche absolvieren, die Behörden überprüfen und die Kundenzufriedenheit überwachen. - Gewährleisten Sie die finanzielle Unterstützung des Dienstleistungs- und Margenbereichs, die Kosten und die Effizienzmöglichkeiten. Mansion und Verantwortung für den operativen und unterstützenden Betrieb des Kunden - Priorisieren und koordinieren Sie die umfangreichste technische Unterstützung, garantieren Sie die Zeitspanne für den SLO-Einsatz und die wirksame Lösung. - Agire im Hauptkontakt, ohne dass dies abgeschlossen ist, in der Eskalation oder in der Kontroverse, garantiert Transparenz und Lösungen, die den Kunden orientieren und proaktiv den direkten Vorgesetzten informieren. - Überwachung der Qualität der Interventionen, der technischen Resoconti und der Post-Service-Kommunikation. Führung des Technikteams – Garantiert, dass das Team ein hohes Maß an technischem Wissen über die verschiedenen Produktlinien, einschließlich technologischer und maschineller Erweiterungen, bereitstellt. - Beaufsichtigen Sie den Arbeits- und Verfügbarkeitsbereich, achten Sie auf die Sicherheit und das Risiko. - Förderung einer Sicherheitskultur, Normkonformität und Professionalität bei allen Interventionen. - Leiten Sie die regelmäßigen Bewertungen der Mitarbeiter durch und koordinieren Sie die Ausbildungsmitarbeiter mit der Personalabteilung und dem Direttore del Servizio. descriptionByLocale.en:
Technical Service Specialist (TSS), SPO BNA - Bobst North America Apply now Bobst North America is the sole distributor for Bobst Group SA, manufacturer of Converting Equipment for the Printing and Packaging industry. The objectives of this position are to ensure that all technical service, support and coordinating activities of the Bobst SPO product line are executed in such a way as to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction. In addition, the incumbent will ensure that we provide world class Customer field service support for the Bobst SPO product line, reflecting the requirements of the Customers and utilizing all the resources available. Technical Service Specialist : The Technical Specialist is an expert on all aspects of Bobst SPO equipment. This role provides technical support to sales, customers, Service Center and Field Service Technicians. The key functional expectation is the research and communication of technical information and updating activities in the Salesforce and SAP. This practice ensures that the most accurate information on customer status is available on a real time basis. The Technical Specialist works closely with his supervisor, colleagues and internal customers to ensure a constant and accurate exchange of technical information. The ultimate goal is to ensure that customer needs and expectations are met, based on the customer’s expectations and the internal service objectives. The TSS is expected to lead by example and to build excitement and enthusiasm within the Service Team. He/she is a team player and takes responsibility for providing excellent customer service. The TSS is flexible with the customer and balances patience and professionalism while driving for solutions with demonstrated urgency. The ability to follow-up on all activities and projects, particularly coordinating date changes with all internal and external customers, is a key expectation of this role. The TSS performs this role with confidence, enthusiasm, and the desire to serve both internal and external customers. The TSS has effective communication, problem solving and follow-up skills. A key expectation of this role is ensuring that the team works together proactively to develop knowledge management solutions that reference and document information on behalf of customers, in addition to Salesforce and SAP. TSS keeps his cool under pressure and works with other team members and throughout the company to negotiate win-win solutions that serve the customer and the needs of the business. The TSS takes responsibility for helping the customer, even outside of his core area of competence, by directing the caller to the appropriate department, ensuring the customer is called back in a timely manner and/or confirming coordination and resolution between other departments. The role requires limited travel within the markets to visit customers to understand their needs and expectations. Representing the company is expected. This is a full-time position with the typical work week being Monday-Friday and may include occasional travel. The TSS works closely with the sales, service center and Regional Service Managers throughout North America. Main 
• Responsibilities: 1. Ensure customer satisfaction Review and analyze job layouts and samples for the existing customers. Investigate and/or support others regarding performance problems with new or existing applications. Provide “after hours” customer phone support as requested. 2. Support the sales team and RSMs through customer visits Clarify trip objectives and create an Absence Form to ensure prompt communication with supervisor. This assists in alerting all internal customers, eliminating duplication of effort, ensuring that there is adequate phone coverage and provides information to others about the status of a customer need. The TSS is expected to follow-up on customer commitments, provide a Trip Report to the supervisor, by the next business day, and follow up on commitments through coordination with internal customers. The TSS is responsible for ensuring that the office workload is managed appropriately and, if slippage occurs, communicates with supervisor to agree on prioritization of effort. 3. Support Field Service Technicians Communicate with respect and patience. Coach, mentor and train field service technicians in the diagnosis, repair, and performance of Bobst equipment. Display sensitivity to technicians, particularly when they are in the presence of the customer. Provide information to Field Service technicians to ensure that they are correctly informed prior to any critical intervention and to ensure that technical support is available as required. Provide feedback to management on technician performance and areas for improvement. Utilize the applicable skills database to deploy local, capable technicians for the specific job as well as technicians whose growth plan includes more exposure to particular kinds of machine interventions and/or training. 4. Support Regional Service Managers Provide technical support and information for newly installed equipment. Serve as or work with the designated Installation Leader for new equipment installations. Follow all approved procedures for Acceptance Tests. Develop and coordinate PIP initiatives for the installed base of machines. 5. Support the Training Initiatives and Programs Establish and perform customer training in the field from time to time when requested. Programs should also include internal sales, RSM and field service training programs. 6. Support the Parts Department Provide assistance to identify difficult parts or part assemblies. Validate parts and assemblies based on specific equipment and machine manufacturer serial number. 7. Machine Warranty Management Ensure that the warranty procedure is correctly applied and that costs are managed to be in compliance with Group guidelines. More specifically, follow guidelines for returned parts inspections to confirm customer compliance as requested. 8. Participate in trade shows, company expositions and other industry events as needed. Take an active role in researching the competition as well as developing market knowledge of customers, peripheral vendors and key suppliers. Key Daily Tasks: Respond to incoming requests for technical support from internal and external customers. Communicate with the PL to resolve open issues on the Pending Matters list When asked, provide input on the field service technician best suited for a service visit. Communicate regularly with the Technical Service Manager and Product Line Managers. Identify opportunities to solve customer problems by recommending spare parts, field repair Perform related duties as assigned or required to meet company goals and objectives. Maintain skill level information, validate with colleagues as necessary Contact existing customers on a regular basis, through visits or telephone contact, within the objectives set and with regard to ongoing projects.

On s'attend à ce que le TSS donne l'exemple et - Fournir un support technique et des informations pour les équipements nouvellement installés. - Servir ou travailler avec le responsable d'installation désigné pour les nouvelles installations d'équipement. - Suivre toutes les procédures approuvées pour les tests d'acceptation. - Développer et coordonner les initiatives PIP pour la base installée de machines. - Soutenir les initiatives et les programmes de formation - Mettre en place et effectuer des formations clients sur le terrain de temps à autre sur demande. - Les programmes doivent également inclure des programmes de formation aux ventes internes, à la GRS et au service sur le terrain. - Soutenir le service des pièces - Fournir une assistance pour identifier les pièces difficiles ou les assemblages de pièces. - Valider les pièces et les assemblages en fonction du numéro de série du fabricant de l'équipement et de la machine. - Gestion de la garantie des machines - S'assurer que la procédure de garantie est correctement appliquée et que les coûts sont gérés conformément aux directives du Groupe. - Suivez les directives pour les inspections des pièces retournées afin de confirmer la conformité du client comme demandé. - Participer à des salons professionnels, des expositions d'entreprise et d'autres événements de l'industrie au besoin. - Jouer un rôle actif dans la recherche de la concurrence ainsi que dans le développement de la connaissance du marché des clients, des fournisseurs périphériques et des fournisseurs clés. Tâches quotidiennes clés - Répondre aux demandes entrantes d'assistance technique des clients internes et externes. - Communiquer avec le PL pour résoudre les problèmes en suspens sur la liste des questions en suspens - Lorsque demandé, fournir des commentaires sur le technicien de service sur le terrain le mieux adapté pour une visite de service. - Communiquer
